meta.subject: Modified enable for req_pipe_reg to use stall logic correctly

en.summary: This commit fixes a real handshake bug in VX_mem_streamer. The request pipeline, request-sent bookkeeping, and response-valid generation are corrected so partial stalls and partial responses no longer freeze the pipe or suppress a legitimate completion.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says the req_pipe_reg enable was using stall logic incorrectly.
The patch is localized to one DUT RTL module and changes handshake predicates rather than comments or tracing only.
The modified conditions directly control when requests advance, how sent subrequests are tracked, and when a caller sees a completed response.
disqualifiers: The commit fixes several closely related predicates in the same module, not just one line.
A small amount of the patch is cleanup of now-unused stag_empty.
evidence: req_pipe_reg enable changed from ~(| mem_req_stall) to mem_req_stall != mreq_valid.
req_sent_mask is now updated only when mem_req_stall != mem_req_valid, instead of updating on every incomplete request.
crsp_valid no longer depends on ~stag_empty in either partial-response or full-response mode.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A memory streamer often expands one logical request into several lane or shard requests. In that case, backpressure is vector-valued: some subrequests may have been accepted while others still stall. If the pipeline advance condition collapses that vector into a simple reduction-OR stall test, the streamer can hold or advance at the wrong time. The associated sent-mask bookkeeping then drifts, and response-valid logic tied to an empty-tag check can hide a legitimate final response.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A logical memory request fans out to multiple subrequests and only some of them are backpressured or only some responses have returned.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reduce the vector stall state to a scalar OR-style hold condition and reuse that simplified condition for sent-mask bookkeeping or response-valid gating.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: collapse vector stall state to scalar OR
portability_notes: Apply this to streamers, coalescers, or burst generators that manage multiple outstanding subrequests under one logical request.
If the target DUT issues only one request at a time, the more relevant mutation is to spuriously gate response valid with an empty-tag or empty-queue check.
The bug is about inconsistent interpretation of partial progress, not about one specific queue implementation.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the stage that launches several subrequests and tracks which subrequests have already been sent.
Change the pipeline-enable condition so it simply checks whether any stall bit is asserted, rather than comparing the stall vector against the request-valid vector.
Use the same oversimplified condition for the 'sent mask' update, or gate completed-response valid with an empty-tag check that can deassert too early.
Test a case where only part of the request is accepted in one cycle and the rest must retry.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_mem_streamer request pipe enable, sent-mask update, and completion valid generation
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes req_pipe_reg.enable and req_sent_mask updates to use mem_req_stall != mreq_valid, and it removes the unnecessary stag_empty gating from crsp_valid.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_mem_streamer.sv, req_pipe_reg.enable changed from ~(| mem_req_stall) to mem_req_stall != mreq_valid, and the same comparison was added around req_sent_mask updates.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under partial backpressure, the streamer can freeze or replay the wrong subset of subrequests, and completed responses can be dropped or delayed even though the underlying memory response arrived.
evidence_for_injection: mreq_valid is a vector of per-subrequest valids, and mem_req_stall is a vector of per-subrequest stalls, so vector-sensitive logic is required.
The fix updates both the pipeline enable and the sent-mask bookkeeping, showing the bug was not purely local to one register enable.
crsp_valid was also ungated from stag_empty, confirming there was a completion-visibility problem on the response side.
notes: The cleanest reinjection is to restore the old request-pipe enable and sent-mask condition together.
If only one mutation is desired, restoring the old req_pipe_reg enable is the primary fault because it drives the rest of the bookkeeping drift.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 VX_mem_streamer 中真实的握手错误。修复后，请求流水推进、已发送请求记账和响应有效判定都能正确处理部分 stall 与部分响应，不会再错误冻结流水或隐藏本应可见的完成响应。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确指出 req_pipe_reg 的 enable 使用 stall 逻辑有误。
补丁局部集中在一个 DUT RTL 模块中，修改的是握手谓词而不是仅改注释或 trace。
被修改条件直接决定请求何时前进、已发送子请求如何记账，以及调用方何时看到完成响应。
disqualifiers: 该提交同时修复了同一模块中几个彼此相关的谓词，而不只是单独一行。
补丁中有少量内容只是把现在不再需要的 stag_empty 标成 unused。
evidence: req_pipe_reg 的 enable 从 ~(| mem_req_stall) 改为 mem_req_stall != mreq_valid。
req_sent_mask 现在只有在 mem_req_stall != mem_req_valid 时才更新，而不是对每个未完成请求都更新。
在 partial-response 和 full-response 两种模式下，crsp_valid 都不再依赖 ~stag_empty。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: memory streamer 往往会把一个逻辑请求扩展为多个 lane 或 shard 子请求。在这种情况下，背压是向量化的：有些子请求可能已经被接收，有些仍然被阻塞。如果流水推进条件把这个向量错误地简化成 reduction-OR 式的单比特 stall 判断，就会在错误的时机停住或推进流水。与之配套的 sent-mask 记账会随之漂移，而把响应 valid 额外绑到 tag 队列是否为空，也可能隐藏本应可见的最终完成响应。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 多 lane 请求的 stall 记账
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一个逻辑内存请求被拆成多个子请求，且只有部分子请求被背压，或只有部分响应先返回。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把向量 stall 状态错误简化为标量 OR 式 hold 条件，并把这种过度简化的条件复用于 sent-mask 记账或响应 valid 判定。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 把向量 stall 状态折叠成标量 OR
portability_notes: 适用于在一个逻辑请求下管理多个子请求的 streamer、coalescer 或 burst generator。
如果目标 DUT 一次只发一个请求，则更相关的故障是用 empty-tag 或 empty-queue 条件去错误地屏蔽 response valid。
该 bug 的本质是对“部分进展”的解释不一致，而不是某一种具体队列实现。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到负责发射多个子请求并记录哪些子请求已发送的那一级逻辑。
把流水 enable 条件改成只看是否存在任意 stall 位，而不是比较 stall 向量与 request-valid 向量。
对 sent-mask 更新也复用这个过度简化条件，或者用 empty-tag 检查去错误地屏蔽完成响应 valid。
测试一个“本周期仅部分子请求被接受、其余必须重试”的场景。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_mem_streamer 的请求流水使能、sent-mask 更新和完成响应有效生成
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 req_pipe_reg.enable 和 req_sent_mask 更新条件统一改成 mem_req_stall != mreq_valid，并去掉了 crsp_valid 对 stag_empty 的不必要依赖。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_mem_streamer.sv 中，req_pipe_reg.enable 从 ~(| mem_req_stall) 改成了 mem_req_stall != mreq_valid，同样的比较也被加到了 req_sent_mask 更新逻辑上。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在部分背压场景下，streamer 可能冻结或重放错误的子请求子集，并且即使底层内存响应已经到达，完成响应也可能被丢弃或延后。
evidence_for_injection: mreq_valid 是每个子请求的有效向量，mem_req_stall 也是每个子请求的 stall 向量，因此必须使用向量敏感逻辑。
修复同时改动了流水 enable 和 sent-mask 记账，说明 bug 并不是某个单独寄存器使能的小问题。
crsp_valid 也被去掉了 stag_empty 依赖，进一步证明响应侧确实存在完成可见性问题。
notes: 最干净的回注方式是同时恢复旧的请求流水使能与 sent-mask 条件。
如果只做一个变异，优先恢复旧的 req_pipe_reg enable，因为它会驱动后续记账漂移。
